title: Careers in Their Own Words
shared_passage: Listen to six people share their personal work experiences, and for questions 1 to 6, choose the correct answer.

questions.question: James...
options: isn't very happy about his job.

questions.question: Linda...
options: worked in a car dealership as a graphic designer.
is now doing what she likes best.

questions.question: Carlos...
options: wants to keep working in a bank but more hours.
has just got a full-time job.

questions.question: Emily...
options: decided to quit her last job.
would like to get a part-time job.

questions.question: Nadia...
options: has retired to help her daughter.

questions.question: Ben...
options: would like to work on different projects.
would like to be self-employed someday.
